I have farmed in Iringa for many years, and on this 0.84 hectare plot I grow local varieties intercropped together. I will apply manure that I have collected from my animals, but chemical fertilizer is too costly for this plot and the soil here in the Southern Highlands is still reasonably fertile. With my family we will work the land with hand hoes as we always do, and I will hire some extra help when the land preparation and weeding is heavy because the rains will come soon.
